title: Fix an off-by-one bug in range()
prompt: The file `range.js` has a function `range(start, end)` that should return an inclusive array of integers from `start` to `end` (e.g. range(1, 4) -> [1, 2, 3, 4]). It currently has an off-by-one bug. The test file `verify.test.js` is present and must pass. Read range.js, find and fix the bug, then run `node --test verify.test.js`. Do NOT modify the test file.
